<aside class="blog-tldr not-prose"><div class="blog-tldr__label">TL;DR</div><div class="blog-tldr__body">
- Twelve items across three domains
- Gain-sharing needs early documentation
- Data use must stay purpose-limited
- AI needs centralized oversight
</div></aside>

Achieving **hospital compliance** under CMS TEAM comes down to 12 operational must-haves.

## Data & infrastructure

1. Unified 30-day episode data across hospital, SNF, home health and outpatient settings.
2. Real-time (or near-real-time) episode identification and patient attribution.
3. Accurate HCC/comorbidity documentation and coding (Optum found two-thirds of episodes at one facility had zero HCCs coded).
4. Predictive analytics for readmission and cost risk.

## Clinical operations

1. Standardized perioperative and discharge protocols.
2. A post-acute network of preferred, high-performing SNFs and HHAs.
3. A primary-care referral workflow that satisfies TEAM’s requirement.
4. Post-discharge follow-up (calls within days; a PCP visit within 7–10 days).
5. Physician engagement and gainsharing/co-management arrangements.

## Finance & reporting

1. Target-price modeling and reconciliation forecasting.
2. Composite Quality Score tracking (HWR, PSI 90, THA/TKA PRO-PM).
3. A deliberate track selection and a 2027 downside-risk exposure model.

According to Rainfall Health, its platform can bring a hospital to R.A.I.N. Compliant™ status in approximately 10 weeks — a company claim.

## Frequently asked questions

### What are the three domains of the CMS TEAM compliance checklist?

Data/infrastructure, clinical operations, and finance/reporting.

### Which quality measures matter for CMS TEAM compliance?

The Hospital-Wide Readmission (HWR) measure, PSI 90, and the THA/TKA PRO-PM.

### What is CMS TEAM's primary-care referral requirement?

Hospitals must refer each covered patient to primary care as part of the post-discharge episode.

### When must a hospital select its CMS TEAM track?

Track selection must be made before each performance year begins.

### When does downside financial risk start under CMS TEAM?

2027, which is Performance Year 2.
